$comment: Client content changes on top of the Figma screens (feedback 2026-11-16, docs/feedback/2026-11-16/README.md). Applied by build-screens.mjs to the kiosk build only; --figma builds the design exactly as in Figma for the verify harness. Every edit names the screen, the Figma node (data-node) and the reason. Ops: text (replace the node's text), remove (drop the node), visaMark (the word VISA drawn as text in Figma becomes the Visa wordmark), swap (exchange two nodes), cloneAfter (copy a node right after itself, with new texts; the copy's ids get a suffix), go (the screen's tap target, instead of the manifest's), drop (screen left out of the journey). When Figma is updated with a change, delete its edit here.
